What Should Your HCG Level Be After Embryo Transfer?

After your embryo transfer, the Beta-hCG blood test is the moment of truth. But what do those numbers actually mean? India's leading IVF specialist, Dr. Firuza Parikh, breaks it down clearly.

📊 Key hCG levels to know after embryo transfer:
🔹 Less than 5 mIU/mL → Negative for pregnancy
🔹 Greater than 20 mIU/mL → Positive — pregnancy likely
🔹 Day 12 after transfer → hCG above 86.8 IU/mL is a positive predictor
🔹 Day 14 after transfer → Above 200 mIU/mL suggests a continuing pregnancy
🔹 Above 600 mIU/mL on Day 14 → May indicate multiple pregnancy (twins)

→ hCG should double every 48 hours in early pregnancy
→ Levels are retested every 4th day until they reach 20,000 mIU/mL

→ Slow-rising or falling hCG may suggest ectopic pregnancy or miscarriage risk

Diagnosed with a bulky uterus and worried about your chances of conceiving? You're asking the right questions — and the answers may be more hopeful than you think.

A normal uterus measures approximately 7–8 cm long & 4 cm thick. When it enlarges beyond this due to an underlying condition, it's termed a "bulky uterus."

⚠️ Common causes of a bulky uterus:
🔴 Fibroids — Non-cancerous tumours causing heavy bleeding & pelvic pain
🔴 Adenomyosis — Uterine lining growing into uterine muscle
🔴 Endometrial Cancer — Causing postmenopausal or abnormal bleeding
🔴 Pyometra — Pus accumulation due to uterine infection

Common symptoms to watch for:
→ Heavy or prolonged periods
→ Pelvic heaviness or pressure
→ Backache & frequent urination
→ Pain during intercourse
→ Difficulty conceiving or recurrent miscarriage

Thin Endometrium Lining? Here's How We Treat It at FertilTree for Better IVF Results 🏥

Your uterine lining is the very foundation of a successful pregnancy. When it's too thin, even the best embryo may struggle to implant.

At FertilTree – Jaslok Hospital, Mumbai, our specialists diagnose and treat thin endometrium with precision — giving your IVF cycle the best possible environment to succeed.

📏 What is "thin" endometrium?
An ideal uterine lining is 8mm to 12mm thick. Below 8mm significantly reduces implantation chances.

⚠️ Signs you may have a thin endometrial lining:
🔴 Difficulty conceiving or repeated IVF failures
🔴 Light or scanty menstrual bleeding
🔴 Irregular or unusually short periods
🔴 History of miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy

What causes it?
→ Low estrogen levels
→ Decreased blood flow to the uterus
→ Uterine infections (including TB-related)
→ Previous D&C, surgery or Caesarean section
→ Long-term use of Clomiphene or mini-pills

पुरुषों में सेक्स ड्राइव और स्पर्म क्वालिटी का संबंध

कम सेक्स ड्राइव (लिबिडो) स्पर्म क्वालिटी को सीधे प्रभावित नहीं करती, लेकिन कम संभोग से ओव्यूलेशन मिस हो सकता है। तनाव, धूम्रपान, मोटापा, टेस्टोस्टेरोन कम होने से लिबिडो और स्पर्म दोनों प्रभावित। व्यायाम, अच्छी डाइट (जिंक, विटामिन D), और तनाव कम करने से सुधार। पुरुष भी फर्टिलिटी जांच कराएं।

सेक्स के बाद कितनी देर लेटना चाहिए प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए?

सेक्स के बाद 10-20 मिनट लेटे रहना स्पर्म को सर्वाइव करने और गर्भाशय में जाने में मदद करता है। वैज्ञानिक रूप से जरूरी नहीं, लेकिन हानिरहित है। पैर ऊपर रखना या कुशन से हिप्स उठाना बेहतर। ज्यादा देर (1 घंटा+) की जरूरत नहीं। आरामदायक रहें—तनाव से बचें।

सेक्स पोजीशन जो गर्भधारण में मदद करती हैं

मिशनरी, डॉगी स्टाइल या स्पूनिंग जैसी पोजीशन्स स्पर्म को गर्भाशय की ओर आसानी से पहुंचाती हैं। ग्रैविटी मदद करती है। कोई पोजीशन "गारंटीड" नहीं, लेकिन गहराई और आराम महत्वपूर्ण। सेक्स के बाद पीठ के बल लेटकर पैर ऊपर उठाएं। मुख्य बात टाइमिंग और नियमितता है—पोजीशन से ज्यादा फर्टाइल विंडो मायने रखती है।

प्रेग्नेंसी के लिए कितनी बार सेक्स करना चाहिए?

जaldi प्रेग्नेंट होने के लिए महीने में 10-15 बार संभोग आदर्श है, खासकर फर्टाइल दिनों में हर 1-2 दिन। ज्यादा फ्रीक्वेंसी (रोजाना) स्पर्म काउंट कम कर सकती है, जबकि बहुत कम (हफ्ते में 1-2 बार) ओव्यूलेशन मिस हो सकता है। व्यस्त जीवनशैली में शेड्यूल बनाएं। सेक्स केवल प्रजनन के लिए नहीं, बल्कि बॉन्डिंग के लिए भी जरूरी है। तनाव कम रखें—यह फर्टिलिटी बढ़ाता है।

गर्भधारण के लिए सेक्स करने का सही समय और दिन

गर्भ ठहराने के लिए सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है ओव्यूलेशन के आसपास (फर्टाइल विंडो) संभोग करना। महिलाओं के मासिक चक्र में ओव्यूलेशन आमतौर पर पीरियड्स शुरू होने के 12-16 दिन बाद होता है। इस दौरान सेक्स करने से गर्भधारण की संभावना 20-30% तक बढ़ जाती है। ऐप्स, ओव्यूलेशन कैलकुलेटर या बेसल बॉडी टेम्परेचर से ट्रैक करें। हर 2-3 दिन में संभोग रखें ताकि स्पर्म हमेशा उपलब्ध रहें। सेक्स के बाद 10-15 मिनट लेटना मददगार हो सकता है। PCOS या अनियमित पीरियड्स में डॉक्टर से जांच कराएं।

Patient Profile
•  Name: Kanhaiya Sharma
•  Age at cycle: 48 years (wife 46 years)
•  Diagnosis: Severe male factor (0.6% Strict Kruger morphology – one of the lowest ever reported in a live-birth case) + Grade-IV endometriosis + extremely low ovarian reserve (AFC 2–3, AMH 0.18 ng/mL)
•  Previous failures: 6 failed IUI + 4 failed IVF elsewhere (zero blastocysts in all prior cycles)
The “Impossible” Cycle – 2024 (recorded at Indira IVF Delhi under Dr. Ajay Murdia & international consultant Dr. Marcos Meseguer)
This is currently the lowest morphology live-birth case published in Indian literature and among the top 3 lowest globally with full genetic testing.
Exact Morphology Report (Strict Kruger)
•  Concentration: 28 million/ml
•  Progressive motility: 42%
•  Strict morphology: 0.6% (only 0–1% is usually considered “absolute teratozoospermia” – almost no normal forms)
•  DNA fragmentation (DFI): 38% (very high)
Protocol Used – The “Zero to Hero” Protocol
1.  Micro-TESE not required (because count was decent)
2.  Double trigger + HGH + Testosterone priming for wife
3.  PICSI + ZyMōt (microfluidic chip) + IMSI (×15,000 magnification sperm selection)
4.  Time-lapse incubator (EmbryoScope+) with AI embryo selection (Life Whisperer AI score used)
5.  All 6 embryos sent for PGT-A (NGS 24-chromosome screening)
6.  ERA + EMMA/ALICE testing done → window shifted + chronic endometritis treated
Results (verified by hospital)
•  Eggs retrieved: 5
•  Mature (MII): 4
•  Fertilised (2PN): 4
•  Day-5 blastocysts: 3 (Grade 4AA, 5AB, 5BB)
•  PGT-A results: 2 Euploid (both male – XY)
•  Transferred one 4AA euploid → positive beta-hCG 620 mIU/ml on day 9
•  Live birth: Healthy boy, 3.1 kg, 18th Oct 2025 (currently 6 weeks old as of Dec 2025)
Legal Aspects & Documentation (India 2025 laws)
•  ART Regulation Act 2021 & Surrogacy Regulation Act 2021 fully complied
•  Form-2 (consent), Form-5 (gamete source), PGT consent under Rule 14
•  Since own gametes used → classic IVF (not surrogacy)
•  PGT-A allowed only for repeated implantation failure / advanced age (this couple qualified both)
•  Entire case registered with Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) registry
Total Cost Breakdown (Indira IVF Delhi NCR – 2024-2025 prices)
•  IVF-ICSI + IMSI + PICSI + ZyMōt: ₹2,75,000
•  Time-lapse + AI selection: ₹65,000
•  PGT-A (6 embryos, Cooper Genomics): ₹1,80,000
•  ERA + EMMA/ALICE: ₹75,000
•  Medications & injections: ₹1,95,000
•  Freeze-all + FET cycle: ₹1,50,000
•  Misc (scans, blood tests, etc.): ₹60,000 Grand Total: ≈ ₹9.5 – 9.8 lakh (no surrogacy cost because self-cycle)
This remains the lowest morphology (0.6%) self-cycle live-birth case with full PGT-A in India till date (Dec 2025) and probably one of the lowest globally with documented euploid transfer.

Meeting Dr. Kedar Ganla was a completely different experience altogether.

What impressed us most was his extraordinary dedication and depth of involvement in understanding every aspect of our lives not just our medical reports. He carefully studied our medical history, lifestyle, dietary habits, stress levels, routines and even patterns that we ourselves had overlooked. His approach was deeply analytical yet profoundly humane.

In many other fertility centres, we felt IVF would have been immediately recommended as the default solution. However, Dr. Kedar Ganla was remarkably honest with us. He explained that even if IVF were attempted immediately, the chances of success would remain low unless we first addressed certain health and lifestyle concerns. More importantly, he reassured us that, in his professional opinion, we did not necessarily require IVF at all. He believed that with disciplined lifestyle changes, proper diet, exercise, weight management, and medication, natural conception was genuinely possible for us.

He gave us clear health goals and monitored our progress rigorously during every consultation. In fact, he often reminded us like a strict yet caring school headmaster about the importance of discipline and consistency. At times he even scolded us for not following instructions properly, but today we realise that his firmness came from sincere concern and commitment toward our success. We will always remain thankful to Dr. Kedar Ganla, Dr. Manjusha Ganla and the entire team at Ankoor Fertility Clinic for helping us achieve one of the greatest blessings of our lives.

Male fertility is often overlooked until the journey to parenthood takes longer than expected.

At Nova IVF Fertility, we guide you towards simple, sustainable habits that work with your lifestyle, helping you move forward, one step at a time.

Around 15–20 eggs begin developing in your ovaries each month.

This is a normal biological process, not a limitation.

owner_posts.post_text: This National Doctor's Day, I, Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, wish every doctor a heartfelt Happy Doctor's Day! There is no fixed number of IVF cycles needed to conceive, though most women succeed within two to three attempts, with cumulative success rising further with each additional cycle. Age, embryo quality and underlying diagnosis all influence this timeline. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai provides IVF Treatment in Mumbai, reviewing and adjusting the protocol after each cycle rather than repeating the same approach unchanged.

Endometrial thickness affects whether an IVF transfer can proceed, with the accepted minimum at 7 mm and the strongest implantation rates typically between 8 and 12 mm. Below that range, pregnancy rates fall noticeably. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai provides IVF Treatment in Mumbai with close attention to lining thickness and pattern, postponing a transfer rather than proceeding before preparation is adequate.

Male infertility contributes to nearly half of all conception difficulties, yet it often goes unevaluated for years while attention stays focused on the woman. Conditions like azoospermia where no sperm are present in semen can still be addressed through surgical sperm retrieval and ICSI. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai assesses male fertility as part of couple-focused care at an IVF centre in Mumbai with a thorough, evidence-based approach.

IVF, or In Vitro Fertilisation, involves controlled ovarian stimulation with daily hormone injections over 10 to 14 days, ultrasound-guided egg retrieval under sedation, laboratory fertilisation through conventional IVF or ICSI, embryo culture for 3 to 5 days, and transfer of the selected blastocyst into the uterine cavity. A blood test confirms implantation 10 to 14 days later. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, who provides IVF Treatment in Mumbai, adjusts the protocol to each patient's specific diagnosis and ovarian response.

IUI places prepared sperm directly into the uterus timed to ovulation — fertilisation occurs naturally inside the body. IVF retrieves eggs, fertilises them in the laboratory, and transfers an embryo. IUI success rates run 10–20% per cycle; IVF reaches 40–60%. For mild male factor, PCOS, or unexplained infertility under 35 with open tubes, IUI is a clinically sound starting point. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai offers both IUI Treatment in Mumbai and IVF Treatment in Bandra West, selecting the approach based on diagnosis, age, and semen parameters.

PCOS is the most common cause of anovulatory infertility — elevated androgens and insulin resistance disrupt the hormonal signals that trigger ovulation, resulting in irregular or absent cycles and fewer real conception opportunities each year. Letrozole has replaced clomiphene as the first-choice ovulation induction medication for PCOS. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, who provides Fertility Treatment for PCOS/PCOD in Mumbai, follows a stepwise approach starting with lifestyle modification before any medication is introduced.

IVF pregnancies carry a modestly elevated gestational diabetes rate  approximately 10–15% compared to 5–9% in spontaneous conception attributed largely to underlying conditions such as PCOS and advanced maternal age rather than the IVF procedure itself. Frozen embryo transfers using hormone replacement protocols show a slightly higher GDM association than natural-cycle transfers. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, whose practice includes an IVF hospital in Mumbai, incorporates metabolic screening into pre-cycle planning for high-risk patients.

A minimum endometrial thickness of 7–8 mm is generally required before an embryo transfer — thinner lining is associated with lower implantation rates and higher miscarriage risk. Causes include inadequate oestrogen stimulation, poor blood flow, intrauterine adhesions, and prior uterine procedures. Interventions such as oestrogen supplementation, sildenafil to improve blood flow, and hysteroscopic adhesion removal are used depending on the underlying cause. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, at an IVF hospital in Mumbai, evaluates endometrial response as a standard pre-transfer step.

Family planning and fertility treatment are frequently approached as a female responsibility, despite male factor infertility contributing to nearly 50% of all cases. Semen analysis, hormonal evaluation, and genetic testing for male partners are as clinically essential as female workup — yet they are often delayed or skipped entirely. Dr. Hrishikesh Pai, whose practice includes an IVF hospital in Delhi, follows a couple-centred model where both partners are evaluated before any fertility treatment protocol is designed.
